section: Summary of Benefits for the High Option of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. - 2026

rows.High Option Benefits: Medical services provided by physicians: Diagnostic and treatment services provided in the office
rows.You pay: In-network: $20 copay per primary care provider for covered office visit; $30 copay specialist for covered office visit Out-of-network: 35%* of covered professional services

rows.High Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Inpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: $100 per admission copayment and 10% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: $300 per admission copayment and 35%* of the Plan allowance

rows.High Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Outpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 10%* of other hospital charges Out-of-network: 35%* of other hospital charges
In-Network: 25%* of the Plan allowance Out-of-Network: 25%* of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.High Option Benefits: Mental health and substance misuse disorder treatment:

rows.You pay: Network pharmacy, 30 day supply: • Generic - $10 copay • Preferred Brand - 25% up to $200 • Non-Preferred Brand - 40% up to $300
Mail order pharmacy, 90 day supply: • Generic - $25 copay • Preferred Brand - 25% up to $400 • Non-Preferred Brand - 40% up to $900
Network preferred pharmacy, 30 day supply: • Generic - $9 copay • Preferred Brand - 20% up to $150 • Non-Preferred Brand - 35% up to $200
